plan.english: Sky is father, Earth is mother.
Dawn, daughter of Sky, become bright! We praise you.
The sun lights up the earth, and the moon lights up the night.
God, you are bright, and you know us.
The dawn is the daughter of the sky. She is bright.
It thundered, and the rain-cloud rained.
The river carries water, and we drink it.
The star is shiny in the night, and we look at it.
We sing a song to him, and he hears well.
Let us praise the dawn! May she hear us!
Fire is a god. It knows us.
The earth nourishes the cattle, and she carries us.
Mother, we praise you! Give us strength!
The daughter of the sun drives the horses, and she is bright.
The sun follows the washed one, and she is walking.
The night went away, and the washed one arrived.
The cloud is thundering, and we are afraid.
The gods are givers, and they see us.
Fire is in the water, and it burns.
The earth trembled in fear, and the cattle were trembling.
The sparrow is trembling in the night, and it is afraid.
He sat down, and the praiser sang a song.
The god stands in the water, and he looks at us.
The east is red, and the black one is leaving.
The fire devours the field. Do not devour us!
Praiser, sing the song! Let the god hear it!
Who is the giver? The god is the giver.
Fire burns, and the water is wet.
Let us praise Fire, and let us pray!
He set the stars in the sky and the moon in the night.
It blows, and the rain-cloud comes.
He has seen the praiser, and he knows him.
The splendor is white, and the light is red.
Bright one, hear us, and give us strength!
Father, listen! We are singing to you.
He is a giver, and we are giving him honey.
The waters are deep, and they carry the light.
The moon is white, and the stars are shiny.
He gave a horse to the king, and the king became joyful.
O Waters, you nourish the sheep, and you protect us.
O Waters, you are mothers. Give us honey!
We trust the gods, who give us cattle.
Fire is the brother of the waters, and it is bright.
Sky is the father of the gods, and he has seen us.
Who drives the cattle? The red one drives the cattle.
Let us sing to him, and let us become joyful!
Let us give honey to him, and let us eat!
Let us look at the moon! May she become bright!
Let us go to the dawn! May she hear us!
The praiser woke up at dawn, and he sang.
Fire, you protect the sheep, and you lead us.
Fire heats the water, and we cook it.
We speak, and he listens.
The red one is standing in the east.
Sun, stand up, and become bright!
Fire, become strong, and burn!
White ones, drink the honey, and become joyful!
Shiny one, see us, and hear us!
White one, go to the field, and eat!
Moon, shine! May we know you!
The gods are not afraid. They are standing steady.
The spring carries the shiny water, and the sparrow drinks it.
The light came forth from the water, and it became bright.
May there be light! And may we see it!
The four horses carry the sun, and they are awake.
The brother sings, and the sister listens.
The king speaks to them with a song, and they hear him.
The shine of the fire is bright, and it burns.
Splendor grew up in the water, and it grew.
Black one, you are awake. We see you.
She is wearing the light, and we see her.
She clothes the field with shine, and she drives the team.
The river swells with rain, and we are afraid.
The knower sings the song, and the king listens.
The god knows the king, and he gives him honey.
The earth lies flat, and the sheep are lying down.
The two rivers carry water, and they swell.
Let us plough the field, and let us work!
He gave us a lifetime, and we praise him.
Let us rejoice! The light became bright.
Give us cattle and horses, and protect us!
Give us strength, and may we grow!
Give us a lifetime, and may we live!
Protect the sheep from the wolf, and do not leave them!
Protect us, and may we be satisfied!
May the rain-cloud rain, and may the river become full!
May the dawn become bright for us, and may we see her!
Gods, hear us, and protect us!
May the field be productive, and may the sheep grow up!
Do not strike us down! Give us strength!
May we not be thirsty, and may we drink the water!
Father, lead us, and look at us!
Come to us, and hear us well!
Let us become strong, and let us eat!
Let us speak to them! May they know us!
Do not leave us, and protect us!
May we see the sun, and may we live!
May we know the gods, and may they know us!
Give us what is right, and arrange it!
Show us what is right, and let us know it!
May the father and the mother live, and may they be satisfied!
May the honey become tasty, and let us drink it!
Let us work, and let us eat the honey!
May the king overcome the wolf, and may he be strong!
Give us honey and fat, and let us eat!
Protect the brother and the sister, and cover them!
May the water become warm, and let us drink it!
May the water not dry up, and let us sip!
Let us swim in the river, and let us become sated!
Do not be afraid, and do not tremble!
Wake up, and stand up!
Sit down, and drink the honey!
Let us pray to him! May he hear us!
Let us ask for light! May he give it!
Let us sacrifice a ram to him! May he be satisfied!
Brother, sacrifice the ram, and let me speak!
Lift us up, and seat us!
May we become rich, and may we grow!
Let us arrive at the fortified height, and let us sit down!
Eat, and become sated!
May we not tremble in fear, and may we stand steady!
Brother, set the fire, and let us become warm!
Sister, boil the water, and let us drink!
Sister, sing, and let us hear well.
Brother, stand firm, and do not tremble!
Cover us, and protect us!
Let us go to the border, and let us stand steady!
Let us yoke the team, and let us drive!
May the berries grow, and may we eat them!
Let us drink the broth, and let us become sated!
Give us a share, and lead us!
May the bow not break, and may we be able!
May the ear listen, and may we hear well!
Let us sit on the slope, and let us seek!
Who will protect us? The father will protect us.
Seek the broth, and carry it!
Be awake, and look at us!
Do not go away, and hear us!
May we be satisfied, and may we become sated!
Praiser, say the song to him! May he know it!
Wolf, go away from the sheep, and do not come!
Do not seize the egg! Let it go!
Thief, go away from the field, and do not come near!
Thief, vanish, and become tired!
Possessed one, slip and go astray, and lie flat!
May the thief fall down, and may he become thirsty!
Possessed one, become tired, and sink!
Dog, protect the horse, and be awake!
Dog, be awake, and listen!
The wolf is gone, and the ram lay down.
Ram, lie down, and become slack!
Let go of the awl, and go away!
Liver, become warm, and do not tremble!
Limb, stand firm, and become warm!
Gut, become slack, and be sated!
Liver, become full, and stand up!
Ear, hear well, and listen!
Do not become cold! Become warm!
I smear the limb with fat, and may it grow.
I smear the gut with fat, and may it become sated.
I smear the ear with juice, and may it hear.
Possessed one, go away from the liver, and do not come!
May the possessed one vanish, and may the liver become full!
Dead one, do not come near, and lie down!
Fire, burn the thief, and may he vanish!
River, do not swell, and become slack!
Rain-cloud, go away, and may the light become bright!
May the wolf be struck down, and may he sink!
May the possessed one burst, and may he not arrive!
Dog, seize the thief, and grasp him!
Dog, drive the ram to the fortified height, and lie flat!
Sparrow, do not tremble, and live!
Egg, do not burst, and grow!
Quern, turn, and do not break!
Beard, grow, and become strong!
May the dead one not come near the ram, and may he lie flat!
Straighten the limb, and lift it!
Stretch the limb, and make it stand!
May the limb not be red, and may it become warm!
I sing to the liver, and I smear it with fat.
It is getting dark, and the wolf comes. Dog, be awake!
May the sparrow live, and may it grow!
May the egg be growing, and may it become strong!
Make the team stand up, and lead it!
Do not kill the sparrow, and let it live!
Sink to the bottom, and do not come!
May the dog hear well, and may he wake up!
May the possessed one not see the egg, and may he go astray!
Dead one, sit down, and do not stand up!
May the gut not be pierced, and may it be full!
The washed one stood up, and the black one lay down.
Sky and Earth split apart, and brightness came forth.
The red one arrived, and she drove the horses.
The shiny one struck down the thickest one, and he sank.
The black one thundered, and it rained.
The egg split, and the light came forth.
She created the bow, and she gave it to him.
He was lifting the star, and he set it on the slope.
The daughter went to the spring, and she drank honey.
She saw the barefoot one, and she became joyful.
The giver gave honey to the knower, and the knower became joyful.
The praiser sang, and the knower heard him.
The four came forth from the egg, and they were going.
The aquatic one went to the bottom, and she was lying flat.
The sister sat down at the crossing, and the aquatic one came forth from the spring.
The two sisters went to the border, and they were lying down.
The night went away, and the light became bright.
The eastern one became bright, and the washed one came forth.
It rained, and the spring became full.
The spring was boiling, and the deep one was swelling.
The giver seized the bow, and the bow did not break.
He sat down at the border, and he looked at the bottom.
The dead one stood up and went into the bottom.
The star flashed up, and the spring became cold.
The aquatic one became afraid, and she was trembling.
The brother-in-law lay down, and the watcher woke up.
The watcher saw the dead one, and he became afraid.
The watcher sat down at the border, and he became tired.
The shiny one split the slope, and the water came forth.
The wet one lay down on the bottom, and she became cold.
The two arrived, and they spoke.
The sixth one became strong, and he seized the juice.
The washed one was driving the team to the crossing, and she was working.
She clothed herself in light, and she was walking.
The white one hit the thickest one, and the thickest one split.
The red one struck the dead one, and he became slack.
He struck the slope, and the slope split.
The mother was sitting at the crossing, and the daughter came.
The daughter spoke, and the mother heard her.
He made the border and the crossing, and he was walking.
The aquatic one was nourishing the berries, and the berries grew.
The barefoot one arrived at the crossing, and she was sitting down.
The thickest one was trembling, and he became afraid.
The twofold one vanished, and the watcher woke up.
The watcher found the juice, and he drank it.
He grasped the bow, and he struck the thickest one.
The deep one covered the bottom, and she was creeping.
The aquatic one ate up the berries, and she became sated.
The watcher was astonished, and he spoke.
The deep one became restless, and it thundered.
He drove the team to the border, and he swallowed.
The barefoot one spoke to her, and she was speaking.
The sixth one succeeded, and he was satisfied.
She grew fond of him, and she gave him juice.
The sixth one became rich, and he gave her a lifetime.
She took the juice, and she drank it.
He gave the juice to the knower, and he went.
The white one struck the black one, and the black one sank.
She became bright in the east, and she drove the team.
He gave the knower a lifetime, and he vanished.
